name: Spec Rows
job: Name a few labelled choices and what each one covers, as hairline rows in running text or as side-by-side cards when the reader is meant to pick.

anatomy.role: Label column and definition, split by hairlines
Semibold; in the cards variant, mono uppercase cyan with a dot
`.spec.cards`: each row a surface card, two columns, stacking on a phone

states.name: Cards
states.note: Two choices the reader picks between.

use_when: Two to four named options, each needing a sentence of scope.
Cards when the reader is asked to choose; rows when the labels only define terms.
avoid_when: Do not use it for a single inline term; that is 50 Term Definition.
Do not put prices or terms in a card; those belong in 41 Offer Close.
access: A real `dl` with `dt` and `dd`, so a screen reader pairs each label with its definition.
The cards variant's dot is decorative (generated content); the label text carries the meaning.
Grid tracks use `minmax(0, 1fr)`; long text wraps inside the card.

used_by.name: Louisville proposal (louisville.arcs.care/proposal), page-local today; swap in after the send

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it line for line.
`artifact_wrap_lint.py` and `page_gate.py` on every page that carries it; sweep 360 to 1440, including 700 to 1000.
